SELECT
FROM meeting_room
AND room_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{roomName}, '%')
AND location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{location}, '%')
AND capacity >= #{minCapacity}
AND FIND_IN_SET(#{equipment}, equipment)
AND status = #{status}
ORDER BY id ASC
